text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The business district is bustling due to New Year's sales.
In the midst of all that, Hiyori bumps into {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
正月の初売りで賑わう繁華街で、
{0}はヒヨリと出会った。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, it's Mr. Knight!
What's up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんだー！　
やっほー！
何してるの？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Same here, funnily enough!
My tummy's been rumbling all day!
That kind of makes me sound like Peco, doesn't it? Ahaha.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっかー！　
あたしもだよー！
ずっとおなかペコペコー！　
あははっ、
なんかペコさんみたいだね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You know how we all went to see the first sunrise of the year, right?
After that I was helping out with the Menagerie's New Year's party
right up until yesterday. Talk about being busy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなで初日の出を見に行ったあとは、
昨日までずーっと、
動物苑の新年会のお手伝いしてて、
大変だったんだー

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
And today we had to do all the cleanup,
so I still haven't had a bite to eat yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日もさっきまで後片付けしてたから、
まだなんにも食べてなくて……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think I'd bump into you today though,
so this is a nice surprise. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
騎士くんに会えると思ってなかったから
うれしいなー♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Errr... I assume your tummy was responsible for that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ～……
今の音、
騎士くんの？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You must be starving!
text_block_list.orig_text: すっごくお腹空いてたんだね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Um... Sorry. That was me. Ehehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うあぁ……
今のはあたし。
えへへ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about we grab some food together, then?
There's so much good-smelling stuff around here that
I can't hold back anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
一緒に食べ歩きしない？
出店からの匂いがおいしそうで
あたし、
もう我慢できないよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's get rolling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんだよ！　
それじゃあさっそく
レッツゴー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
The question is what do we start with?
Is there anything you fancy?
choice_data_list: There's an enticing fragrance coming from over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何から食べようかなー？
騎士くんは食べたいもの、
決まってる？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: *sniff, sniff* Wow! I can smell dangos and shiruko!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くんくん……
ふわぁ、
お団子やお汁粉のいい匂い～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Nothing stirs the appetite quite like the smell of mochi being baked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～！　
お餅を焼く匂いが
食欲をそそられるね～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Phew! The smell alone's making me feel full! Wild!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うううー！
　
もう匂いだけで
お腹いっぱいになりそう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mr. Knight!
Let's just eat anything and everything we want!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ騎士くん！
食べたい物、
ぜ～んぶ食べちゃおう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh man... There's even yakisoba and takoyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ……
焼きそばにたこ焼きまで……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The stall over there's selling chocolate bananas and cotton candy!
Enough talk! Let's get down to business!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
そっちの屋台には、
チョコバナナにわたあめまで！？
よ～し、
突撃だ～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
One box of takoyaki, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん！　
たこ焼き一箱くださーい！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Oh, if it isn't Hiyori!
I hear you took care of my daughter the other day. Thanks for that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいよー！　
おや、
ヒヨリちゃん！
こないだウチの娘の面倒見てくれたんだってな。
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
I scratch your back, you scratch mine and all that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういたしまして！　
困った時は
お互いさまさまだもん！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Really appreciate it.
By the way, you sure you only want one box?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言ってくれると助かるよ。
ところで、
一箱だけでいいのか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can eat that much! Oh, wait.
I need to get Mr. Knight's share as well! One more box, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなにたくさん食べないよー！　
ってそっか、
騎士くんの分も頼まなきゃ！　
もう一箱お願いします！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Got it! Thanks a bunch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいよっ！　
まいどありー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait! Here's your takoyaki!
Anything else you wanna eat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせ騎士くん！　
はいこれ、
騎士くんのたこ焼き！
他に食べたいものってある？

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk 1
text_block_list.text: Hiyori!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒヨリちゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That's my name!
Oh! It's the lady from the taiyaki stall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい？　
あっ！　
たい焼き屋のお姉さん！

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk 1
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me carry all that stuff the other day!
Here's some taiyaki as thanks. On me, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前は荷物を運ぶの手伝ってくれてありがとう！
今日はお礼に
おまけしとくね。
たい焼き、
持ってって！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁー！　
ありがとうございますっ！

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Hiyori.
Fancy some grilled squid? Feel free to take it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃん、
イカ焼き食べたい？　
あげるよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I do!
Are you sure, though?
text_block_list.orig_text:
食べたいです！　
でも、
いいんですか？

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk 2
text_block_list.text:
Sure as can be!
You helped me out a bunch last year, so it's only fair I pay you back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのいいの！　
去年色々助けてもらったし！
ちょっとはサービスさせてよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
Guess I'll take you up on that offer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ……
遠慮なくいただきます！

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hiyori! Take this as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃーん！　
こっちのも持っていきな！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh man! They gave me so much!
I can't hold all this by myself, so let's eat it together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう騎士くんっ！　
こんなにたくさんもらっちゃった！
一人じゃ持ちきれないよー！　
一緒に食べちゃお！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to eat while we walk if we split it!
So take this, this and this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人で分ければ歩きながらでも食べられそうだね！
はいこれっ！　
あとこれと、
これっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
There we go. Good thing you were here with me!
I'd never have been able to eat all this on my own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでよしっと……
騎士くんがいてくれてよかったー！
一人で買いに来てたら食べきれないところだったよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh... This is bad. Both of our hands are full.
Now the both of us can't eat. Ahaha...
choice_data_list: Then I'll feed it to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……
どうしよう騎士くん。
両手がふさがっちゃった。
このままだと二人とも食べられないや、
あはは……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'll do the same for you!
Perfect! We can both feed each other!
Open wide and say \"ahh!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと！　
あたしも騎士くんに食べさせてあげる！
よーし、
二人で食べさせあいっこだね！　
はい、
あーん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ahh!
*munch, munch*
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーんっ！　
はむ、
あむっ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Hehe! Now that's delicious!
How's yours?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー！　
んふふっ！　
おいしー！
騎士くん、
おいしい？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Great! Want another bite?
Then open wide for me again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった！　
騎士くん、
もっと食べる？　
もういっかい
あーん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: ...All the people I helped last year ended up repaying me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
去年あたしが助けた人たちから、
こんなにお礼してもらっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect anything in return when I help people out, but well, 
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't really happy.
It makes me wanna bring smiles to even more faces this year!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼が欲しいから助けてるわけじゃないけど、
それでも
うれしいな……
今年も
もっとたくさんの人を
笑顔にしちゃうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
And first up is you, Mr. Knight! What do you wanna eat next?
A caramel apple? Grilled squid? Come on, feel free to pick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは騎士くんからね！　
次はどれが食べたい？
りんご飴？　
イカ焼き？　
ほら、
選んで選んでっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus the two of them enjoyed the
plentiful amount of food they had been given.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}とヒヨリは、
たくさんの人たちから受け取った食事を、二人で楽しく食べた。
